heroLandscape.prompt: Using the reference gameplay image as strict style guidance, create polished marketing hero art for Starter Kit Racing. Keep the same chunky low poly 3D truck, track pieces, trees, smoke, and cheerful color palette. Enhance lighting and composition only. Do not redesign the vehicle or art style. No UI, no logo. Integrate the exact title text "STARTER KIT" on the first line and "RACING" on the second line directly into the artwork, near the visual center of the wide composition, as one compact floating title logo block suspended in front of the scene. The title must not be painted onto roads, platforms, walls, floors, buildings, clouds, props, or any other scenery. Create exactly one title treatment only. Do not duplicate, repeat, echo, mirror, or restate the title anywhere else in the image. The title text must be part of the image itself, not a flat overlay, and it must use a font style, shape language, material treatment, and color palette that match the game art. Keep the lettering clean, highly readable, premium, and clearly smaller than the main gameplay subject cluster so it supports the composition instead of overwhelming it. Do not add any other words, logos, UI, badges, borders, or translucent title panels.
